about.title: About
about.body: Hi, my name is Marco Sabatini. I'm 28 years old and I'm a junior full-stack developer with an IFTS background. I take my development process seriously: I use TypeScript everywhere, ensure tests are run before any merge, and make CI/CD and linting a standard part of my workflow. I'm drawn to the "invisible" aspects of development—layered architecture, database integrity constraints, and security hardening—because that's what ensures a project stands the test of time. I build using Angular (one of my favorite frameworks), I work with Node/Express and Sequelize for backends, and take pride in crafting high-quality HTML and CSS for my frontends. I'm looking for a team where I can continue to learn and ship code that can be trusted.
about.path: I don't come from a classic IT path. I'm a qualified electrical technician, and before software I worked as an electrician, in warehouses and in deliveries: hands-on jobs where things have to work. I bring the same approach to code.
